problem_text:
A logistics company needs to distribute its total shipping volume across 14 regional hubs to maximize overall delivery efficiency.  
The performance metrics for each hub are as follows:  
* Hub A: efficiency score 0.119, congestion factor 0.035, allocation limits [0.076, 0.518]  
* Hub B: efficiency score 0.069, congestion factor 0.124, allocation limits [0.057, 0.410]  
* Hub C: efficiency score 0.190, congestion factor 0.214, allocation limits [0.009, 0.850]  
* Hub D: efficiency score 0.165, congestion factor 0.268, allocation limits [0.080, 0.498]  
* Hub E: efficiency score 0.123, congestion factor 0.193, allocation limits [0.070, 0.816]  
* Hub F: efficiency score 0.051, congestion factor 0.210, allocation limits [0.010, 0.495]  
* Hub G: efficiency score 0.076, congestion factor 0.139, allocation limits [0.031, 0.593]  
* Hub H: efficiency score 0.181, congestion factor 0.113, allocation limits [0.064, 0.339]  
* Hub I: efficiency score 0.117, congestion factor 0.106, allocation limits [0.077, 0.368]  
* Hub J: efficiency score 0.029, congestion factor 0.067, allocation limits [0.047, 0.587]  
* Hub K: efficiency score 0.025, congestion factor 0.230, allocation limits [0.095, 0.807]  
* Hub L: efficiency score 0.183, congestion factor 0.245, allocation limits [0.014, 0.469]  
* Hub M: efficiency score 0.029, congestion factor 0.033, allocation limits [0.090, 0.509]  
* Hub N: efficiency score 0.089, congestion factor 0.278, allocation limits [0.026, 0.645]  

Each hub must receive a fraction of the total shipping volume within its specified allocation range, and all fractions must sum to 1. To maintain operational flexibility, the company requires that the group of high-availability hubs, represented by the set L = {G, J, L, N}, collectively handle at least 0.158 of the total volume.  
Additionally, the overall network congestion index must not exceed 0.198, and the total efficiency score of the distribution plan must be at least 0.075.  
Determine the optimal volume allocation across hubs that maximizes the total efficiency score while satisfying all constraints.
